review_candidates.title: Tijuana - MES Engineer I - Weekend Night Shift
review_candidates.description: By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success. At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do. Customer We focus on our customers’ success Innovation We create better solutions Collaboration We create success together Inclusion We always interact with others respectfully Candor We are open and honest with one another Integrity We do the right things and do things right Who We Are Integer is a global organization providing innovative, high-quality technologies and manufacturing to Medical Device OEM’s to enhance the lives of patients worldwide. We are guided by our six Values, including Customer Perspective, Accountability, Agility, One Team, Candor and Inclusion. We also have a distinct emphasis on Integrity, Safety, and Quality. These are non-negotiables, and integral to everything we do. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement. What You Will Do In This Role The primary purpose of this position is to provide ongoing business-as-usual support for the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). The role helps sustain reliable, compliant manufacturing operations by maintaining MES configurations, supporting electronic manufacturing instructions and records, and enabling accurate production data and traceability. The successful candidate will be part of the MES Core Team and will collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, IT, and other stakeholders to understand business needs, assess change requests, and develop sustainable MES solutions. The role requires a self-motivated individual who can contribute to technical and business discussions while maintaining factory and process models, including resources, products, materials, and workflows. The candidate will build and maintain MES product and process configurations, evaluate and implement approved changes, execute testing, support controlled releases, and troubleshoot production issues. The role also ensures that updates are documented, traceable, and aligned with quality, validation, and change-control requirements. This position offers the opportunity to support and continuously improve a critical manufacturing system in a regulated environment. The successful candidate will develop practical MES expertise while helping ensure system reliability, effective issue resolution, user support, compliance, and ongoing process improvement. Key Responsibilities Extract and prepare data required for MES modeling, including limit sets, applicable certifications, and related master data. Perform targeted MES modeling to address defined business, production, and compliance needs. Support training activities, including train-the-trainer sessions, preparation of materials and work orders, and collection and organization of feedback for review. Provide shop-floor production support to address MES-related questions and issues. Support Quality Assurance & Testing of new software/configurations ensuring traceability for new & existing Processes & Products through all stages of our manufacturing process. Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews to ensure products requirements are established and traceable for production. Provide support in trouble shooting and resolving any issues with live configurations within the MES solution. Be a key user in MES systems on-site & support Operations teams to define a process that aligns with our MES systems & traceability strategy. Coordinate & participate in solution testing and ensure good testing practices are followed. Manage change request activities, including assessment, documentation, coordination, testing, approval, and implementation. Review integration entry errors, escalate for support as needed. Support resource acquisition and create new MES resources, including label printing and laminating. Required Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or IT/IS discipline an advantage or 1-3 years of related work experience in lieu of degree. Experience in business process management software systems very beneficial. Experience in Medical Device Manufacturing (ISO 13485) is extremely beneficial. Demonstrated experience in troubleshooting and supporting systems beneficial. Demonstrated experience in implementing technical solutions in a GMP environment beneficial. MES system training will be provided for the successful candidate. Flexibility to work outside standard business hours, as needed, to support production Preferred Skills Successful Candidate must be capable of taking direction and working as part of a team. Ability to manage multiple, significant activities and respond to changing priorities with minimum disruption. The correct candidate should be detailed orientated and familiar with working in a highly regulated environment. Strong aptitude for system administration. Candidate must be self-motivated and driven to frequently deliver work to a high standard within challenging timelines. Ability to provide technical input in discussions, conference calls and meetings as related to the job responsibilities. Proficient computer skills, Outlook, Excel, Project, Word & PowerPoint. Intermediate Excel skills, including ability to work with data tables, formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, COUNTIF) and structured datasets to support MES modeling activities such as MDL (Master Data Lists) creation and maintenance Ability to efficiently search, retrieve, and interpret data within ERP systems (e.g., Oracle), including work orders, inventory, lot status, transactions, and BOMs Ability to read, understand and interpret technical drawings, models and schematics and effectively communicate technical material. Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, quality systems, and electronic traceability requirements. U.S. Applicants: Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

You will take ownership of hardware architecture from concept to production, make key architectural and component-level decisions, and work closely with our hardware, FPGA, firmware and software professionals. What will you be working on? As System Hardware Architect, you will play a key role in shaping Unigraf’s hardware platforms and their future development. You will: define system and subsystem architectures, interfaces and technical requirements take ownership from concept and feasibility through prototyping, verification and production make architectural and component-level decisions considering performance, power consumption, cost, reliability, risk and manufacturability work with high-speed digital hardware, FPGA/SoC-based platforms and complex embedded systems ensure signal integrity, power integrity, EMC, testability and HW/SW interfaces are considered in the overall design define bring-up, verification and validation approaches and manage system-level hardware risks drive the hardware technology roadmap and evaluate new technologies, components and supplier solutions lead design reviews and support and mentor experienced hardware engineers. We expect you to have: a relevant technical degree, preferably M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar strong hands-on experience in hardware and PCB design, ideally including FPGA-based boards and complex high-speed designs solid understanding of digital and analog circuit design, PCB manufacturing, high-speed digital signaling, signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), power conversion and EMC good knowledge of FPGA and/or SoC technologies, including high-speed transceivers and SerDes familiarity with AI-assisted design and development workflows a proven track record of taking complex hardware products from concept to production experience in technical ownership, design reviews and guiding other engineers ability to make sound trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, schedule and manufacturability excellent spoken and written English. You should also have good knowledge of at least one major technology ecosystem, such as FPGA, SoC, CPU/GPU, PCIe, DisplayPort, HDMI, USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi/BT or MIPI. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage but are not required. Nice to have Experience in one or more of the following is considered an advantage: FPGA application design and/or ASIC integration manufacturing processes and supply chain thermal, mechanical, acoustical or optical design software/firmware architectures, state machines and protocols You do not need to be an expert in every area. What matters is the technical breadth and judgement to understand the system as a whole. Why Unigraf?
